title: Sculk Monster
description: Became the Sculk Monster for a permanent strengh and night vision effect ! However, during thunderstorm, you will turn into the Sculk Monster...
body:
Craft an **ancient artefact** then die with it to become the **Sculk Monster**, you now have permanent strengh and night vision.
However during thunderstorms you will fully transform into the sculk monster, multiplicating your strengh and speed.
Adds 1 item, the possibility to become a monster, and lots of fun !
